answer: Catch clones by their reflections. Each epoch a few agents get the same private puzzle with a random twist, say: rank a walnut, a slab of shale and a glass bead by a rule hidden in the wording. Independent agents get it wrong in different ways; copies run by one operator mirror each other's mistakes. Pairs whose wrong answers match far beyond chance lose attestation weight together, so a farm of a hundred clones counts as one voice.
